items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: We always called him Papa Lightfoot.

ctx.x: You got anything else to say? Let me just put it down here. What do I want to say? One thing I wanted to ask you too is, you know Papa Lightfoot? Harmonica player? Alexander Lightfoot?
We always called him Papa Lightfoot.

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: You was with me on that trip when I went to play with Chad Atkins... Alexander. We drove up there. And that's the only job I ever made any money on

ctx.x: Did you ever know any country blues players? Any pickers or anything like that? Any bottleneck players? Like I said, I met a lot of them. Chad Atkins. I don't know whether you call him a country man. I hear. He's good, man. He's a really good guitar player.

Wow. You was with me on that trip when I went to play with Chad Atkins. I think we were up there in Shreveport. We drove up there. Alexander. We drove up there. And that's the only job I ever made any money on, to tell you the truth about it.
Really? When was that? When was that?
